target_customer: Mobile app companies with subscription paywalls
problem: Apps lose revenue because paywalls and funnels are tested slowly and manually.
business_model: B2B SaaS for paywall building, testing and analytics
product_category: Mobile app monetization and automated experimentation

founders.name: Zach Witzel
founders.background_notes: YC page says he ran growth experiments at Uber worth over $100M.

founders.name: Anish Doshi
founders.background_notes: Named in YC launch post, not the founder section.

technical_complexity.rationale: Cross platform SDKs, no release paywall rendering and statistical experimentation are standard but nontrivial; the AI optimization layer adds difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: SDK integration creates some switching cost, but paywall tooling is copyable and several vendors already existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: These vendors compete today; no acquisition of Helium found.

market_need_then: Subscription apps depend on paywall conversion; pilot customer Locket reports over 75% subscription revenue growth per the company blog.

branding.domain_note: Uses tryhelium.com, implying the exact name domain was not used

identity.voice_and_tone: Positions as self improving software and app monetization for the AI era

brand_strength.rationale: Common word shared with many companies including a crypto network and a browser; no brand coverage found.

outcome_analysis: Helium is an active company with Uber, Alexa and Meta experience that sells paywall tooling and plans an AI experimentation layer, citing customers such as Locket and Wispr. The company blog reports a $2M raise from YC, Gradient Ventures and Daybreak. It competes in a crowded paywall tooling market, and no exit or setback was found.
notes: Blog date conflicts (Feb 4 2026 versus page metadata Nov 9 2026); aggregators say total $5.4M, a job post says $6M, and a $550K pre-seed July 2024 (Merak) appears on aggregators; all unverified. The $2M stage is not stated so stage is other. No second outlet found. Competitor pages found were dated 2026, so competitors are not recorded as of founding. Founder education not found.
